quote: Cullen numbers were first studied by Irish mathematician James Cullen in 1905
note: James Cullen introduced Cullen numbers (n·2^n+1) in 1905 and observed properties about their primality. While it is conjectured that there are infinitely many Cullen primes, the exact year the conjecture was formally posed is not explicitly stated in available sources. 1905 represents when Cullen first studied these numbers.
